assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: All submitted polygons (site_boundary, key_areas, land_use, buildings, roads, green_space, public_space, phasing) use SRC-PROVISIONAL-BOUNDARIES-2026 with official_boundary=false.
assumptions.impact: Areas, ratios, and counts are indicative only; must be recalculated after official SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA polygons are published.

assumptions.statement: The '一核·两轴·三带·四组团' spatial structure and narrative design content originate from the user-provided haidian_design.md and have been integrated into proposal.md.
assumptions.impact: Design concept is author-derived; professional review should validate planning rationale against official controls.

assumptions.statement: AI scenarios (ai-traffic-walkability, enterprise-service-copilot, public-safety-operations-review) are mapped to agent_taskbook scenarios but lack operational pilots.
assumptions.impact: Scenario feasibility is conceptual; deployment requires validation with district data partners.

assumptions.statement: proposal.en.md is generated as bilingual contract version 1 with structural alignment to proposal.md; technical terms retain Chinese context where needed.
assumptions.impact: Translation fidelity is structural, not literal; professional review should verify key planning terms.

assumptions.statement: drawings/a3-booklet.pdf and drawings/a0-boards.pdf have been regenerated with substantive bilingual design content (overview map, three key-area designs, scenario cards, component/wayfinding, phasing & responsibility) via scripts/regen_drawings_pdf.py, replacing the scaffold placeholders; a3 and a0 no longer share the same sha256.
assumptions.impact: Drawings now carry substantive content for review; geometry remains provisional pending official SITE_BOUNDARY/KEY_AREA polygons. manifest.json sha256 must be recomputed to match.

assumptions.statement: buildings.geojson footprints are indicative massing derived from provisional boundary partitioning, not from official cadastral or planning-approved building data.
assumptions.impact: Building footprint area (310807.184 sqm) and derived FAR are indicative only; must be recalculated against official building stock.
